E0170

A `Dyn` value is not a condition

What

A `Dyn` value is not a condition

Why

Dyn has no implicit truthiness

Fix

Write `if d.decode<Bool>() ?? false -> …`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0170: tests/ui/dyn_condition.stderr.

Error [E0170]: A `Dyn` value is not a condition
  --> dyn_condition.jet:5:12
    |
  5 |     if row.active -> print("active")
    |            ^^^^^^
 Why: Dyn has no implicit truthiness
 Fix: Write `if d.decode<Bool>() ?? false -> …`
